facts.fact: ABNORM, the Agence Burkinabe de Normalisation, de la Metrologie et de la Qualite, signed a framework convention with the telecoms regulator ARCEP on 4 February 2026 on managing Object Identifiers, naming ARCEP's Executive Secretary the national registration authority; the document names no standard issued and does not itself state the body's legal basis.

systems.country_label: Agence Burkinabe de Normalisation, de la Metrologie et de la Qualite

note: The OID convention sets up an identifier registration regime, not a named national IT standard, so no published fact; OID registry is class other.
